# Social Evidence Research

A research method that turns public or user authorized social material into a report where every claim points to the inspected material behind it. The workflow sets the protocol before collecting (question, platforms, date range, selection method, sample cap, stopping rule), treats search results and previews as discovery only records that can support no claim, records each inspected part of a source as its own evidence record, groups reposts and cross posts so repeated content counts once, attributes every comment to its commenter, builds a claim table linked to evidence ids and locators, and reports discovery, inspection, exclusion and access gap counts with their limits. It also audits existing social research reports for discovery only evidence, double counted reposts, misattributed comments and claims that go beyond the sample. It works read only: no posting, liking, following, messaging or logging in on your behalf, and no working around login gates, paywalls or rate limits: each block is recorded as an access gap.
